St James Investment Company Lifted Its Anheuser Busch Inbev Sa/Nv (BUD) Stake by $2.51 Million; Golub Group Has Lowered Holding in Apple (AAPL) as Shares Rose 
  Nellie Frank 
Golub Group Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 40.63% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Golub Group Llc sold 163,820 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 239,384 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $36.89M, down from 403,204 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Golub Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $905.15 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.32% or $0.58   $178.39. About 38.93 million shares traded or 10.18% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
St James Investment Company Llc increased its stake in Anheuser Busch Inbev Sa/Nv (BUD) by 210.74% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 31,090 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.71M, up from 10,005 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
